```diff
diff --git a/test/query-record.property.test.ts b/test/query-record.property.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/query-record.property.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import fc from 'fast-check';
+import { encodeRecord } from '../src/query-record';
+
+const scalar = fc.oneof(
+  fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 0xd7ff }),
+  fc.integer({ min: 0xe000, max: 0x10ffff }),
+).map((point) => String.fromCodePoint(point));
+
+const scalarString = fc.array(scalar, { maxLength: 24 })
+  .map((characters) => characters.join(''));
+
+it('orders keys by code point across the BMP/supplementary boundary', () => {
+  fc.assert(
+    fc.property(
+      scalarString,
+      fc.integer({ min: 0xe000, max: 0xffff }),
+      fc.integer({ min: 0x10000, max: 0x10ffff }),
+      scalarString,
+      scalarString,
+      (prefix, lowerPoint, higherPoint, lowerValue, higherValue) => {
+        const lowerKey = prefix + String.fromCodePoint(lowerPoint);
+        const higherKey = prefix + String.fromCodePoint(higherPoint);
+        const record = Object.fromEntries([
+          [higherKey, higherValue],
+          [lowerKey, lowerValue],
+        ]);
+        const expected =
+          `${encodeURIComponent(lowerKey)}=${encodeURIComponent(lowerValue)}&` +
+          `${encodeURIComponent(higherKey)}=${encodeURIComponent(higherValue)}`;
+
+        expect(encodeRecord(record)).toBe(expected);
+      },
+    ),
+    {
+      seed: 20260919,
+      numRuns: 200,
+      examples: [['', 0xe000, 0x10000, '', '']],
+    },
+  );
+}, 5000);
```
